import os
path='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485762/attempts/600043634274485a8fca1406353e4b51/system/state/workspace/programs/task-bd405395.py'

code='''def transform(grid):
    # The solid divider separates two panels. The lower-panel bar counts
    # select the fill color; the upper right bar sets the square size.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    c2 = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(sep + 1, len(grid))))
    c4 = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(sep + 1, len(grid))))
    n2 = sum(grid[r][c2] == 2 for r in range(sep + 1, len(grid)))
    n4 = sum(grid[r][c4] == 4 for r in range(sep + 1, len(grid)))
    size = sum(grid[r][c4] == 4 for r in range(sep))
    color = 2 if n2 == n4 else 4
    return [[color for _ in range(size)] for _ in range(size)]
'''
